name: chronos
description: Detect Codex degradation, approval loops, quota amplification, rule risks, rollout duplication, SQLite churn, and coordinate bounded read workers on Windows.

interface.longDescription: Check Windows process, memory, disk, diagnostic-log, token-quota, approval persistence, permission-rule, reviewer-escalation, lineage, fork-context, and rollout health, then coordinate bounded Codex read tasks using runtime model discovery, canonical workspace identity, advisory leases, privacy limits, and coordinator verification.
defaultPrompt: Use Chronos to inspect current Codex resource health.
Use Chronos to explain current token and approval pressure.
Use Chronos Governor to plan one bounded repository read task.
